historical_reviews.deepseek: Preserves the two-channel concept but its transport and parsing undermine credential safety and evidence integrity.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly treats Redfish and IPMI values as protocol-specific observations that require same-SUT, close-time sampling and normalization.
historical_reviews.adjacent_context: Unlike the previous destructive Power Cycle case, this case is strictly read-only and must not issue power control to resolve a disagreement.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-01/03 require command/source fit; ED-07/08 preserve complete evidence; ED-17 protects TLS/credentials; ED-36/38 separate review from DUT verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify Redfish and IPMI independently report the same correct physical power state for the exact SUT at substantially the same time.
original_method: Resolve exact Redfish ComputerSystem and IPMI channel identities, take secure structured read-only observations with synchronized timestamps, normalize each protocol's vocabulary through an approved mapping and preserve any disagreement for owner adjudication.
manual_activity: The owner confirms target identity, normalization and what physical state is expected; any mismatch or transient requires owner diagnosis rather than an automatic power action.
required_inputs: Exact SUT serial/BMC identity and discovered ComputerSystem resource
Redfish-to-IPMI power-state equivalence matrix including transitional/unknown states
Maximum allowed sample-time skew and expected physical state
TLS CA/host trust and protected credential references
safety_requirements: Use certificate/host-key validation and protected secret injection; no hardcoded/CLI passwords, -k or sshpass
Keep both requests read-only and prohibit chassis power commands
Validate HTTP/JSON and IPMI exit status instead of grep-only evidence
Bind both observations to the same physical serial/BMC and timestamp window
Stop on identity/trust failure or disagreement; preserve the mismatch and do not retry insecurely
agent_execution_scope: Discover/verify exact Redfish and IPMI targets and trust/auth policy
Capture one structured Redfish PowerState/health response and one IPMI power status with close timestamps
Normalize values using only the approved matrix and calculate sample skew
Report raw/redacted observations, equivalence and discrepancies for engineer verdict
Perform no power mutation or independent physical-state assumption
engineer_actions: Supply approved state mapping, time-skew tolerance and expected physical condition
Confirm both paths map to the same SUT and diagnose discrepancies/transients
Review evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Both source protocols are represented, but the command disables trust, exposes multiple passwords and reduces Redfish to grep output; it cannot prove same-target identity, response validity or normalized equivalence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected certificate-validating Redfish and approved IPMI clients, capture complete structured responses/statuses at near-identical timestamps and normalize through the owner matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Redfish ComputerSystem PowerState, IPMI LANplus/cipher-17 comparison and 5/5-minute estimates remain, while hardcoded system/root/0penBmc values are treated as unsafe placeholders.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a correlation envelope containing immutable target identities, monotonic/wall timestamps, raw protocol results, normalized state and time skew; reject any sample outside the identity/time contract.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure discovery, full parsing and temporal/semantic correlation instead of hardcoded credentials, grep and string comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Two strings that look similar may refer to different SUTs or different moments; correctness requires target identity, valid protocol responses, approved mapping and sufficiently close observations.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC caches and transition races can temporarily disagree. The test records such discrepancies but cannot decide physical truth without the owner baseline or authorize a state change.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define transitional states or sampling tolerance differently; the matrix must specify them and cannot convert an unexplained mismatch into PASS.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash, SUT/BMC serial and discovered Redfish resource/IPMI channel
TLS/IPMI auth policy and protected-session audit
Timestamped complete Redfish status/JSON PowerState/health and IPMI raw output/exit status
Approved normalization, sample skew and same-target comparison
No-write/no-secret-leak audit, preserved mismatch diagnosis and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure coherently requires Redfish-to-IPMI comparison and Criteria asks for correct Redfish data. Security defects and the missing normalization/identity contract are execution-readiness issues rather than contradictory source requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Protected access and state mapping gate execution, but a complete static review is possible and no global source-integrity stop is present.

review_improvement: Preserves the dual-channel intent while making identity, time and vocabulary equivalence explicit and preventing a mismatch from triggering unsafe power mutation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Redfish and IPMI expose similar but not necessarily identical state models, and both can be stale during transitions. The meaningful comparison is a tuple of target identity, protocol-valid raw value and timestamp, then an approved normalization—not literal text equality. If observations disagree, repeating until they match would hide a real race or management-plane fault; the discrepancy itself is required evidence.
